message.content: {"note_claim": "Searches of official and news sources show no confirmation of the claimed Jan 2026 deployment of dozens of F-22 and F-16 fighters to Greenland.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Major airfield upgrades are in the works for the U.S. military's base in Greenland even as a diplomatic crisis between the United States and NATO allies in Europe ratchets up over President Donald Trump's push to take control of the territory.", "reason": "This January 2026 news article about U.S. military activity in Greenland discusses airfield upgrades and past deployments but makes no mention of any January 2026 deployment of dozens of F-22s and F-16s, which is consistent with the note's claim but does not directly prove the absence was confirmed through searches."}

parsed.note_claim: Searches of official and news sources show no confirmation of the claimed Jan 2026 deployment of dozens of F-22 and F-16 fighters to Greenland.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Major airfield upgrades are in the works for the U.S. military's base in Greenland even as a diplomatic crisis between the United States and NATO allies in Europe ratchets up over President Donald Trump's push to take control of the territory.
parsed.reason: This January 2026 news article about U.S. military activity in Greenland discusses airfield upgrades and past deployments but makes no mention of any January 2026 deployment of dozens of F-22s and F-16s, which is consistent with the note's claim but does not directly prove the absence was confirmed through searches.
